text.tspan: Share of population living in multidimensional poverty
Multidimensional poverty is defined as being deprived in a range of health, education and living standards
indicators. Estimates based on the most recent household survey data.

tspan.tspan: Alkire et al. (2026) – The Global Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) 2026
A separate dataset is produced to monitor trends over time. Where data for 2014 is unavailable, the value from the closest year
